mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 0.25% within 1 month signals monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in nonfarm payrolls and declines in unemployment rate indicate labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of interaction-triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic recovery, housing starts above 900,000 units and retail sales above $440 billion signal robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of triggered instances during recovery phase, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% within 3 months signals labor market tightness that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Joint increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate accelerating consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% MoM and RSAFS rises > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >60% of interaction-triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdown, industrial production declining below 105.0 indicates weakening supply chain activity that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >60% of INDPRO < 105.0 instances during slowdown, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production over 6 months indicates expanding manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >60% of periods with rising INDPRO trend, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
